Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the text and PRIDE metadata is a characterization of the baseline proteomes of ten different liver cancer cell lines to correlate their protein expression with HEV permissiveness. While the broader study involves numerous perturbations (CRISPR KO, siRNA, drug treatments), these are validated via imaging (RNA-FISH), Western blot, and FFU assays, not via the mass spectrometry proteomics analysis. Therefore, the proteomics dataset itself is a non-perturbation, descriptive study of different cell lines.
